protocol_meta.target_scope: SMTP RFC5321-style local-receive server subset for planning-agent debugging

channels.name: control_and_data
channels.purpose: 每个 accepted TCP connection 同时承载 SMTP command line、response line、AUTH continuation line 和 DATA body line。

runtime_implications.summary: server runtime 使用 nonblocking socket 与 epoll，向上层分发 accept、readable、writable 和 close 事件。
SMTP 输入按 LF 终止的文本行从 per-connection input buffer 弹出；返回给协议层的 line 不含 LF，也会去除可选 CR。
Outbound response text 先进入 per-connection output queue，再通过 writable interest 和 smtp_connection_flush 发送。
network 层不解析 SMTP verb、AUTH payload 或 DATA 内容；语义解析由 protocol_text、auth 和 server_app 层完成。

roles.name: client
roles.summary: 外部 SMTP client 建立 TCP connection，接收 220 greeting，发送 HELO/EHLO、AUTH、MAIL FROM、RCPT TO、DATA、RSET、NOOP、VRFY 和 QUIT。

roles.name: server
roles.summary: 目标实现是 local-receive SMTP server：维护 per-connection session，验证固定账号，接收 envelope 和 DATA，并把邮件写入本地 .eml 文件。

interaction_units.name: smtp_line
interaction_units.summary: 传输层交给协议层的基本输入单位，是由 CRLF 或 LF 结束的一行文本。

interaction_units.name: smtp_command
interaction_units.summary: 普通 command mode 中，smtp_command_parse 把一行拆分为 verb kind、optional argument 和 has_arg。

interaction_units.name: smtp_response
interaction_units.summary: server responses 是 code + text + CRLF 的文本行；EHLO capabilities 使用 250- continuation lines 和最终 250 space line。

interaction_units.name: mail_transaction
interaction_units.summary: 一次邮件事务由 MAIL FROM、一个或多个 RCPT TO、DATA command、DATA lines 和 '.' terminator 组成。

core_flows.name: connection_greeting
core_flows.summary: accept 后 server 创建 smtp_session_t，加入 session list，并排队发送 220 '<hostname> ESMTP ready'。

core_flows.name: ehlo_greeting
core_flows.summary: client 发送 EHLO domain；server 标记 greeted=true、保存 helo_name、reset transaction/auth exchange，并返回 AUTH LOGIN PLAIN、SIZE 和 8BITMIME capabilities。

core_flows.name: helo_greeting
core_flows.summary: client 发送 HELO domain；server 标记 greeted=true、保存 helo_name、reset transaction/auth exchange，并返回 250 hostname。

core_flows.name: auth_login
core_flows.summary: AUTH LOGIN 可不带 initial username，也可带 base64 username；server 依次请求 username/password challenge，验证 smtpuser/smtppass 后返回 235。

core_flows.name: auth_plain
core_flows.summary: AUTH PLAIN 可带 initial base64 blob，也可进入 continuation；blob 解析出 user/pass 后通过固定测试凭据验证。

core_flows.name: local_receive_delivery
core_flows.summary: authenticated client 依次发送 MAIL FROM、RCPT TO、DATA 和 DATA body；'.' terminator 后 server 写入本地 .eml 并返回 250 accepted。

core_flows.name: transaction_reset
core_flows.summary: RSET 清空 MAIL/RCPT/DATA transaction state 和 AUTH continuation state，然后返回 250 OK。

core_flows.name: graceful_quit
core_flows.summary: QUIT 触发 221 Bye，server 尝试立即 flush control response，然后关闭 TCP connection 并移除 session。

surface_catalog.name: 220_GREETING
surface_catalog.summary: TCP accept 后 server 发送 220 '<hostname> ESMTP ready' greeting。

surface_catalog.name: HELO
surface_catalog.summary: 建立 greeting state，参数必须存在；成功时保存 helo_name 并返回 250 hostname。

surface_catalog.name: EHLO
surface_catalog.summary: 建立 greeting state 并返回 ESMTP capabilities：AUTH LOGIN PLAIN、SIZE、8BITMIME。

surface_catalog.name: AUTH
surface_catalog.summary: 只支持 LOGIN 和 PLAIN mechanisms；需要先 HELO/EHLO，成功后 session->authenticated=true。

surface_catalog.name: AUTH_LOGIN
surface_catalog.summary: AUTH LOGIN flow 支持 optional initial username、base64 username/password continuation、235 success 和 535 failure。

surface_catalog.name: AUTH_PLAIN
surface_catalog.summary: AUTH PLAIN flow 支持 initial base64 blob 或 continuation blob，并解析 user/password 后验证固定 credentials。

surface_catalog.name: MAIL
surface_catalog.summary: MAIL FROM:<address> 设置 envelope sender；需要 greeted 和 authenticated。

surface_catalog.name: RCPT
surface_catalog.summary: RCPT TO:<address> 追加 envelope recipient；需要已设置 MAIL FROM，最多 SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS。

surface_catalog.name: DATA
surface_catalog.summary: 在存在 sender 和至少一个 recipient 后进入 DATA mode，server 返回 354 并把后续行作为 message body 处理。

surface_catalog.name: DATA_BODY
surface_catalog.summary: DATA mode 中每个非终止 line 追加到 session->message_buf；单独 '.' line 终止 message。

surface_catalog.name: RSET
surface_catalog.summary: 清空当前 transaction 和 AUTH continuation，然后返回 250 OK。

surface_catalog.name: NOOP
surface_catalog.summary: 不改变 session state，返回 250 OK。

surface_catalog.name: VRFY
surface_catalog.summary: 不实际验证用户，固定返回 252 Cannot VRFY user, but will accept message。

surface_catalog.name: QUIT
surface_catalog.summary: 返回 221 Bye 并关闭 connection。

surface_catalog.name: UNKNOWN
surface_catalog.summary: 未知或未支持 verb 进入 default branch，返回 500 Command unrecognized。

message_or_command_entries.name: smtp_line
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: bytes ending with LF, optionally preceded by CR
message_or_command_entries.summary: 输入缓冲中必须出现 LF 才产生完整 line；弹出时消费 LF，并去除末尾 CR。

fields.name: line_text
fields.summary: 返回给上层的 NUL-terminated string，不包含 CRLF。

message_or_command_entries.name: smtp_command_line
message_or_command_entries.summary: smtp_command_parse 跳过前导空白，把第一个 token 大写化后映射到 smtp_command_kind_t，剩余文本右裁剪后保存为 arg。

fields.name: verb
fields.summary: 支持 HELO、EHLO、MAIL、RCPT、DATA、RSET、NOOP、QUIT、AUTH、VRFY；其他 token 映射为 SMTP_CMD_UNKNOWN。

fields.name: argument
fields.summary: verb 后剩余非空文本复制到 smtp_command_t.arg，最大目标缓冲为 char[1024]。

message_or_command_entries.name: smtp_response_line
message_or_command_entries.summary: smtp_response_format 使用 '%d %s\r\n' 格式化响应；调用方负责选择 code 和 text。

fields.name: text
fields.summary: human-readable response text 由 server_app 分支提供。

message_or_command_entries.name: ehlo_capabilities_response
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: 250-hostname CRLF 250-AUTH LOGIN PLAIN CRLF 250-SIZE max_size CRLF 250 8BITMIME CRLF
message_or_command_entries.summary: EHLO 成功后声明 AUTH LOGIN PLAIN、SIZE SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE 和 8BITMIME。

fields.name: hostname
fields.summary: server 创建时固定设置为 localhost。

fields.name: max_size
fields.summary: EHLO SIZE capability 使用 SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE。

message_or_command_entries.name: auth_plain_blob
message_or_command_entries.summary: decoded blob 必须包含两个 NUL；实现把 first NUL 和 second NUL 之间的 bytes 作为 user，second NUL 后的 bytes 作为 password。

fields.name: user
fields.summary: user 必须非空且适配输出缓冲，固定有效值为 smtpuser。

fields.name: password
fields.summary: password 必须非空且适配输出缓冲，固定有效值为 smtppass。

message_or_command_entries.name: mailbox_argument
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: FROM:<address> or TO:<address>, with optional whitespace after key
message_or_command_entries.summary: parse_mailbox_arg 以 case-insensitive key 匹配 FROM: 或 TO:，支持 angle-bracket mailbox，也支持无 angle bracket 的第一个 non-space token。

fields.name: mail_from
fields.summary: MAIL FROM 成功后写入 session->mail_from 并设置 has_mail_from=true。

fields.name: rcpt_to
fields.summary: RCPT TO 成功后追加到 session->rcpt_to[rcpt_count] 并递增 rcpt_count。

message_or_command_entries.name: data_block
message_or_command_entries.syntax_or_layout: zero or more DATA lines followed by a line exactly equal to '.'
message_or_command_entries.summary: DATA mode 期间普通 lines 累积到 message_buf 并追加 CRLF；'.' terminator 后落盘或返回错误。

fields.name: message_data
fields.summary: DATA content 存储在 session->message_buf，长度由 session->message_len 跟踪。

fields.name: terminator
fields.summary: line exactly '.' ends DATA mode and triggers storage write or error handling。

fields.name: dot_stuffing
fields.summary: 当前 C implementation 对任何非终止且以 '.' 开头的 DATA line 去掉一个 leading dot。

field_constraints.condition: HELO or EHLO lacks an argument
field_constraints.required_action: return 501 Missing HELO/EHLO domain and do not mark greeted

field_constraints.condition: MAIL, RCPT, or DATA received before greeting
MAIL, RCPT, or DATA received before authentication
MAIL argument is missing or is not FROM: mailbox syntax

field_constraints.required_action: return 503 Need MAIL FROM before RCPT TO

field_constraints.condition: DATA received before sender or any recipient exists
field_constraints.required_action: return 503 Need MAIL FROM and RCPT TO before DATA
mark message_too_large; on terminator return 552 and reset transaction

field_constraints.condition: line length after pop_line is greater than 2048 bytes
field_constraints.required_action: return 500 Line too long and continue processing later lines

state_nodes.name: accepted_connection
state_nodes.summary: TCP connection 已被接受，smtp_session_t 和 smtp_connection_t 已创建，server 已排队 220 greeting。

state_nodes.name: greeted_session
state_nodes.summary: HELO 或 EHLO 成功后 session->greeted=true，session->helo_name 保存 client domain。

state_nodes.name: auth_continuation
state_nodes.summary: AUTH LOGIN 或 AUTH PLAIN 需要更多 input line 时，session->auth_state 进入 LOGIN_WAIT_USER、LOGIN_WAIT_PASS 或 PLAIN_WAIT_BLOB。

state_nodes.name: authenticated_session
state_nodes.summary: smtp_auth_validate 接受固定 credentials 后 session->authenticated=true 且 auth_user 保存 username。

state_nodes.name: mail_transaction_started
state_nodes.summary: MAIL FROM 成功后 has_mail_from=true、mail_from 已保存，rcpt_count 和 message state 被初始化。

state_nodes.name: recipient_collection
state_nodes.summary: 至少一个 RCPT TO 已追加，rcpt_count > 0。

state_nodes.name: data_mode
state_nodes.summary: DATA command 接受后 in_data_mode=true，后续输入行不经 command parser，而由 handle_data_line 处理。

state_nodes.name: closed_connection
state_nodes.summary: QUIT、network EOF/error 或 server close path 关闭 fd；on_close callback 移除并销毁 session。

transitions.trigger: valid HELO or EHLO with argument
transitions.summary: server stores helo_name, resets transaction and auth exchange, and replies 250。

transitions.trigger: AUTH LOGIN without password step or AUTH PLAIN without initial blob
transitions.summary: server sets auth_state and emits 334 challenge。
server decodes base64, validates fixed credentials, sets authenticated=true, and resets auth exchange。

transitions.trigger: AUTH PLAIN or AUTH LOGIN initial flow with valid credentials
transitions.summary: server can authenticate without remaining in continuation after credentials are complete。
server records sender and returns 250 Sender OK。
server appends recipient and returns 250 Recipient OK。
server initializes message buffer, sets in_data_mode=true, and returns 354。

transitions.trigger: DATA terminator '.' and successful local storage
transitions.summary: server writes .eml, returns 250 Message accepted for delivery, and resets transaction。

transitions.trigger: DATA terminator with size overflow or storage failure
transitions.summary: server returns 552 for size overflow or 451 for local processing error, then resets transaction。
server resets transaction and auth continuation, but does not explicitly clear authenticated/greeted state。
server closes TCP connection and removes session resources。

timers_and_constants.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE
timers_and_constants.value_or_rule: 1024 * 1024 bytes; also advertised through EHLO SIZE

timers_and_constants.name: control_line_limit
timers_and_constants.value_or_rule: server_app rejects popped lines with strlen(line) > 2048

invariants.summary: MAIL, RCPT, and DATA require greeted=true and authenticated=true; otherwise server returns 503 or 530 without changing transaction state。
When session->in_data_mode is true, input lines are DATA content or terminator, not SMTP commands。
When session->auth_state is not NONE, input lines are AUTH continuation data, not SMTP commands。
Transaction reset clears sender, recipients, DATA mode, message buffer length and message_too_large flag。

dispatch_keys.name: input_mode
dispatch_keys.summary: server_event_loop first checks in_data_mode, then auth_state, and only then parses normal SMTP commands。

dispatch_keys.name: smtp_command_kind_t
dispatch_keys.summary: normal command dispatch uses smtp_command_t.kind in handle_command switch。

dispatch_keys.name: auth_mechanism
dispatch_keys.summary: AUTH dispatch uppercases mechanism token and supports LOGIN and PLAIN only。

dispatch_keys.name: mail_root
dispatch_keys.summary: completed DATA deliveries route to local file storage under server->mail_root。

dispatch_targets.name: smtp_connection_pop_line
dispatch_targets.summary: network connection layer yields complete input lines from buffered TCP bytes。

dispatch_targets.name: smtp_command_parse
dispatch_targets.summary: protocol_text layer converts command lines into smtp_command_t。

dispatch_targets.name: handle_command
dispatch_targets.summary: server_app central command dispatcher implements HELO/EHLO/AUTH/MAIL/RCPT/DATA/RSET/NOOP/VRFY/QUIT and unknown-command behavior。

dispatch_targets.name: handle_auth_continuation
dispatch_targets.summary: server_app consumes base64 continuation lines for AUTH LOGIN and AUTH PLAIN。

dispatch_targets.name: handle_data_line
dispatch_targets.summary: server_app consumes DATA lines, detects terminator, writes mail, and resets transaction。

dispatch_targets.name: smtp_mail_store_write
dispatch_targets.summary: storage layer writes envelope metadata and DATA content to a unique .eml path。

matching_rules.summary: MAIL FROM and RCPT TO parse uses case-insensitive key matching for FROM: and TO:。
AUTH mechanism token is uppercased before comparison to LOGIN or PLAIN。
The implementation does not perform domain, mailbox existence, relay policy, DNS, MX, or remote recipient routing checks。

resource_objects.name: smtp_connection
resource_objects.summary: Owns fd, input buffer, output buffer, output offset and dynamic capacities for nonblocking TCP IO。

resource_objects.name: smtp_session
resource_objects.summary: Stores control_fd, connection pointer, greeting/auth flags, auth continuation state, envelope sender/recipients, DATA mode and message buffer。

resource_objects.name: smtp_server
resource_objects.summary: Stores listen port, hostname, mail_root, tcp server pointer and linked list of sessions。

resource_objects.name: smtp_mail
resource_objects.summary: Borrowed view passed to storage with helo_name, auth_user, mail_from, rcpt_to list, DATA pointer and data length。

resource_objects.name: eml_file
resource_objects.summary: Local output file named mail_<time>_<pid>_<counter>.eml containing X-SMTP envelope headers, blank line, and DATA bytes。

lifecycle_rules.summary: smtp_session_t is created on accept and destroyed when on_close removes the session node。
smtp_connection_t is created inside smtp_session_create and destroyed inside smtp_session_destroy。
mail_root is created during smtp_server_create via smtp_mail_store_init, and smtp_mail_store_write ensures it exists again before delivery。
A completed or failed DATA transaction calls smtp_session_reset_transaction after terminal handling。

persistence_scope.name: local_eml_only
persistence_scope.summary: Persistent output is limited to local .eml files; no relay queue, retry queue, remote delivery, DNS/MX lookup, durable user database or mailbox index is implemented。

error_matrix.condition: invalid or empty line cannot be parsed as command
recognized command has missing required argument
error_matrix.required_action: return command-specific 501 or 503/530 depending on precondition

error_matrix.condition: invalid AUTH base64 or invalid AUTH PLAIN blob
error_matrix.required_action: return 501 and reset auth exchange where continuation path does so
return 535 Authentication credentials invalid, clear authenticated/auth_user, and reset auth exchange
return 552 Message size exceeds fixed maximum message size and reset transaction
return 451 Requested action aborted: local error in processing and reset transaction

error_matrix.condition: TCP read EOF or read/flush error

recommended_values.name: validation_profile
recommended_values.value_or_rule: Use swaks for AUTH LOGIN happy-path validation and nc for manual AUTH PLAIN / DATA flow checks.

hard_bounds.name: smtp_command_arg
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: smtp_command_t.arg is char[1024] and is NUL-terminated after strncpy

hard_bounds.name: mailbox
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: mail_from and each rcpt_to entry are char[512]

hard_bounds.name: input_read_chunk
hard_bounds.value_or_rule: smtp_connection_read reads up to 4096 bytes per recv loop iteration

configurable_bounds.name: listen_port
configurable_bounds.value_or_rule: main accepts optional argv[1] port in range 1..65535

configurable_bounds.name: mail_root
configurable_bounds.value_or_rule: main accepts optional argv[2] mail_root path

security.name: authentication
security.summary: AUTH is required before MAIL/RCPT/DATA, but credentials are hard-coded to smtpuser/smtppass and no external user database exists。

security.name: tls
security.summary: STARTTLS/TLS is outside the implemented scope; transport is plain TCP。

security.name: relay_policy
security.summary: The server is local-receive only and does not implement relay authorization, DNS/MX lookup, queue retry, or outbound delivery。

must_support_surface.name: HELO
must_support_surface.summary: Accept HELO with domain argument, set greeted state, and return 250 hostname.

must_support_surface.name: EHLO
must_support_surface.summary: Accept EHLO with domain argument and return capabilities for AUTH LOGIN PLAIN, SIZE, and 8BITMIME.

must_support_surface.name: AUTH_LOGIN
must_support_surface.summary: Support LOGIN with optional initial username, base64 continuation prompts, fixed credential validation, and 235/535 responses.

must_support_surface.name: AUTH_PLAIN
must_support_surface.summary: Support PLAIN with optional initial blob or continuation, parse user/password from base64 blob, and validate fixed credentials.

must_support_surface.name: MAIL
must_support_surface.summary: After greeting and authentication, parse FROM: mailbox and initialize a transaction.

must_support_surface.name: RCPT
must_support_surface.summary: After MAIL FROM, parse TO: mailbox and append up to 32 recipients.

must_support_surface.name: DATA
must_support_surface.summary: After sender and at least one recipient, enter DATA mode, accept body lines, terminate on '.', and write local .eml.

must_support_surface.name: RSET
must_support_surface.summary: Support RSET transaction reset with 250 OK.

must_support_surface.name: VRFY
must_support_surface.summary: Support VRFY with the current fixed 252 response.

must_support_surface.name: QUIT
must_support_surface.summary: Support QUIT with 221 Bye and connection close.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: per_connection_session
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: Maintain one smtp_session_t per accepted fd, with greeting, auth, transaction and DATA fields.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: auth_continuation_precedence
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: When auth_state is active, consume input lines as AUTH continuation before command parsing.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: data_mode_precedence
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: When in_data_mode is true, consume input lines as DATA body before AUTH or command parsing.

must_support_state_behaviors.name: local_delivery_lifecycle
must_support_state_behaviors.summary: On DATA terminator, write local .eml and reset transaction regardless of delivery success or failure path.

must_support_error_paths.name: pre_greeting_or_pre_auth_mail_flow
must_support_error_paths.summary: MAIL/RCPT/DATA before HELO/EHLO returns 503; before AUTH returns 530.

must_support_error_paths.name: invalid_auth
must_support_error_paths.summary: Invalid base64 or PLAIN blob returns 501; wrong credentials return 535.

must_support_error_paths.name: oversized_data
must_support_error_paths.summary: Message body larger than SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE returns 552 on DATA terminator and resets transaction.

must_support_limits.name: line_buffering
must_support_limits.summary: Handle TCP stream fragmentation/coalescing by buffering bytes until LF-delimited lines are complete.

must_support_limits.name: message_size
must_support_limits.summary: Enforce 1 MiB DATA message size and advertise the same value through EHLO SIZE.

may_defer_features.name: STARTTLS
may_defer_features.summary: TLS and STARTTLS are not implemented and should not appear in generated specs for this scope.

may_defer_features.name: relay_and_outbound_delivery
may_defer_features.summary: SMTP relay, DNS/MX lookup, queue retry and remote delivery are outside this local-receive example.

may_defer_features.name: additional_sasl_mechanisms
may_defer_features.summary: CRAM-MD5 and other SASL mechanisms are outside scope.

may_defer_features.name: full_rfc5321_validation
may_defer_features.summary: Domain syntax, address grammar, enhanced status codes, mailbox existence checks and relay policy are not implemented.

implementation_assumptions.name: server_only_target
implementation_assumptions.summary: Downstream coder agent should generate server-side local-receive SMTP code; clients are external validation tools such as swaks or nc.

implementation_assumptions.name: text_protocol_not_packet_codec
implementation_assumptions.summary: Use line buffering plus command parsing and response formatting; do not introduce binary packet, decoder_feed, or encoder abstractions.

implementation_assumptions.name: single_process_epoll_runtime
implementation_assumptions.summary: The example runtime is one process using epoll and linked-list session tracking.

planning_inputs.protocol_summary: SMTP RFC5321-style local-receive server subset implemented in C over plain TCP + epoll. The planning target is a server that accepts external clients, sends 220 greeting, supports HELO/EHLO, AUTH LOGIN/PLAIN with fixed credentials, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA local .eml storage, RSET, NOOP, VRFY and QUIT, while intentionally excluding STARTTLS, relay, DNS/MX lookup, queue retry and external user databases.
planning_checklist: 报文模型与编解码范围
文本命令解析与响应格式化
禁止功能与最小可运行范围
测试与互操作验证方式
required_codec_scope: LF-delimited line extraction with optional CR stripping
base64 decode for AUTH LOGIN and AUTH PLAIN
critical_stateful_behaviors: Session is created at accept and receives 220 greeting before client commands.
MAIL/RCPT/DATA require both greeting and authentication.
AUTH continuation lines take precedence over normal command parsing.
DATA mode lines take precedence over AUTH and command parsing.
DATA terminator triggers local storage and transaction reset.
error_handling_obligations: Return 503 before greeting and 530 before authentication for mail transaction commands.
Return 501 for missing syntax or malformed AUTH payloads.
Return 452 when recipient count exceeds SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS.
Close the connection after QUIT or TCP read/write failures.
persistence_and_lifecycle_obligations: Ensure mail_root exists during server creation and before each write.
Write envelope metadata headers before raw DATA content.
Use unique .eml filenames based on time, pid and process-local counter.
Destroy smtp_session_t and smtp_connection_t on close.
coverage_gaps: SASL mechanisms beyond LOGIN and PLAIN
implementation_risks: The C implementation removes one leading dot from any non-terminator DATA line beginning with '.', while the summary consistency rule describes only '..' dot-stuffed lines.
AUTH PLAIN failure with an invalid initial response returns 501 but does not explicitly reset auth_state in that branch.
HELO/EHLO reset transaction and auth continuation but do not explicitly clear an already authenticated flag.
Line length is checked after a complete line is allocated; very long unterminated input can grow the connection input buffer before rejection.
The mailbox parser accepts a bare non-space token in addition to angle-bracket mailbox syntax and performs no address grammar validation.
consistency_findings: SUMMARY.md, smtp_module_spec.json, README.md and source code agree that this is a server-only local-receive SMTP subset.
Module consistency rules and source agree that SMTP is text line based and should not use smtp_packet_t, smtp_decoder_feed or smtp_encoder abstractions.
EHLO capability formatting and session constants agree on SIZE 1048576.
The only notable behavior mismatch is dot-stuffing wording: source removes a leading dot from any non-terminator dotted line, while summary says '..' lines.

open_questions.question: Should generated protocol specs preserve the current broad DATA dot de-stuffing behavior for any leading-dot non-terminator line, or narrow it to standard '..' dot-stuffed lines?
open_questions.suggested_followup: For exact parity with protocol-example/smtp, preserve the source behavior; for RFC-style behavior, update both specs and code.

open_questions.question: Should HELO/EHLO after authentication keep authenticated=true as current code does, or should a new greeting reset authentication?
open_questions.suggested_followup: Keep current behavior in gold facts unless the stabilization task explicitly changes session semantics.

open_questions.question: Should AUTH remain mandatory for local mail submission in this example, even though minimal SMTP receive servers can accept unauthenticated local delivery?
open_questions.suggested_followup: Keep AUTH mandatory because SUMMARY.md consistency rule C3 and server code both require it for MAIL/RCPT/DATA.

evidence_index.excerpt: SUMMARY defines SMTP RFC5321-style example subset, SERVER role, default port 2525, and local-receive scope with HELO/EHLO, AUTH, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, RSET, NOOP, VRFY, QUIT and local .eml storage.
The network module owns TCP/epoll listening, client fds, IO events, connection input/output buffers, and does not parse SMTP command semantics.
Rules require smtp_command_parse for commands, response helpers for responses, greeting/auth before MAIL/RCPT/DATA, AUTH LOGIN/PLAIN only, DATA terminator handling, and local .eml only.
Forbidden symbols/features include smtp_packet_t, smtp_decoder_feed, smtp_encoder, STARTTLS, relay, DNS_MX_LOOKUP, external_user_database and AUTH_CRAM_MD5.
README lists HELO, EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, RSET, NOOP, QUIT, AUTH LOGIN, AUTH PLAIN and local delivery to a configured directory.
README documents default port 2525, mail directory /mail-test, test account smtpuser, password smtppass, max recipients 32, max mail size 1MB and control line length around 2048.
README states each message is written as a .eml file containing envelope metadata headers and raw DATA content.
main defaults to port 2525 and /mail-test, accepts optional port and mail_root arguments, creates and starts smtp_server, then runs it.
smtp_connection_read appends recv bytes to input buffer; smtp_connection_pop_line waits for LF, strips optional CR, consumes the line, and output helpers queue and flush bytes.
TCP server sets sockets nonblocking, listens with backlog 128, accepts clients into epoll, dispatches readable/writable events, and invokes close callbacks.
smtp_command_kind_t enumerates HELO, EHLO, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, RSET, NOOP, QUIT, AUTH, VRFY and UNKNOWN; smtp_command_t stores kind, arg and has_arg.
smtp_command_parse skips leading spaces, uppercases the verb token, maps it to kind, trims trailing argument whitespace, and stores arg if present.
smtp_response_format emits code, space, text, CRLF; smtp_response_format_ehlo_caps emits hostname, AUTH LOGIN PLAIN, SIZE max_size and 8BITMIME lines.
Auth helpers validate smtpuser/smtppass, decode base64 input while skipping whitespace, and parse AUTH PLAIN blobs using two NUL separators.
Storage recursively ensures root_dir, creates unique mail_<time>_<pid>_<counter>.eml files, writes X-SMTP envelope headers, a blank line, and DATA bytes.
smtp_session_t stores control fd, connection pointer, greeted/authenticated flags, helo/auth fields, auth_state, MAIL FROM, RCPT list, DATA mode and message buffer.
smtp_session_reset_transaction clears MAIL, RCPT, DATA and message flags; smtp_session_reset_auth_exchange clears auth_state and auth_login_user.
smtp_server_create validates mail_root, sets hostname localhost, initializes mail storage, installs TCP callbacks and creates the TCP server.
On accept, server creates a session, adds it to the session list, and queues a 220 ESMTP ready greeting.
on_event flushes writable output, reads input, rejects lines longer than 2048, then dispatches DATA mode, AUTH continuation or parsed commands in that order.
handle_command implements HELO, EHLO, AUTH, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, RSET, NOOP, VRFY, QUIT and default unknown-command responses while maintaining session state.
AUTH handling requires greeting, rejects duplicate auth, supports LOGIN and PLAIN with initial responses or continuations, and uses fixed credential validation.
DATA handling appends non-terminator lines with CRLF, removes one leading dot from non-empty dotted lines, terminates on '.', writes mail, returns 250/451/552, and resets transaction.
Function spec maps HELO/EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO and DATA behavior to session fields and command preconditions.
Function spec maps DATA terminator '.' and message_data accumulation to handle_data_line and session->message_buf.
Function spec states verb is the first whitespace-separated token, uppercased into kind, and argument is trimmed and copied to smtp_command_t.arg.
Function spec states EHLO capabilities use 250- continuation lines and final 250 space line.
Function spec states AUTH PLAIN blob must contain NUL, user, NUL and pass, with non-empty user/pass fitting output buffers.
Function spec states SMTP_LINE requires LF before a complete line is returned and the returned value excludes CRLF.
